missing_snotel_policy: exact-date original fixture fallback; never CLIGEN 9999
precipitation_guard: same-water-year consecutive-date cumulative difference; below -1e-9 mm rejects; smaller negative floating residual canonicalizes to zero
temperature_guard: substitute only when finite Tmax and Tmin are both present and Tmax >= Tmin
prn_grammar: six left-justified I5 fields in month, day, year, precipitation, Tmax, Tmin order; precipitation is integer hundredths inch; temperatures are integer Fahrenheit; no 9999 sentinel
quantization_operator: round half away from zero after mm/0.254 for precipitation and C*9/5+32 for temperature
intervention_semantics: P and T are isolated at PRN input columns; realized CLI and snow effects are CLIGEN-mediated bundles and may change storm duration, tp, ip, dewpoint, and interactions
